About executor :
When I created this script, I used Delta, so the executor I highly recommend for mobile users is Delta. As for other executors, I tried to keep the script as minimal as possible. If any executor cannot run my script, it doesn't mean there is a problem with my script.

If you don't have money to buy Wave or AWP.GG, I recommend using Delta or executor with high unc.
Executor for mobile users that I recommend: Delta, Arceus x, Codex, Krnl
Executor for users on the computer that I recommend Wave, AWP.GG, or executors with high unc

About skid :
My script was not skidded from anyone else's script; I created this script using my own skills and knowledge. I am willing to let you compare my script with others to see how my script differs from theirs and why I am so confident in the performance and stability of my own script.

--
Hello, this is Fresh's Script, formerly known as Flores's Script.
Since the last time I uploaded my script, it's been 3 years. Now I'm about to upload a new script of my own, but it's a zombie attack game because I'm bored and have nothing to do, and I'm too lazy to write a script for a bigger game.
But then what? I have learned to make my own script have good performance.

How is my zombie attack script different from others?
This script primarily focuses on performance. This means that your phone or computer might not lag at all while using my script in the long term.
And I wrote this script to minimize bugs as much as possible. Maybe you can use my script overnight without encountering any bugs or lag (I'm not sure because I haven't tested it myself).

Update: After testing for 3 hours, the results clearly show that my FPS didn't drop at all. 😉

But if you encounter a bug while using my script, feel free to contact me.
